blocks.text: Intro
finger snaps, dark walking upright bass, ominous muted trumpet riff
Verse 1
deep weary baritone, fatalistic swagger, snaps loose and human

Welcome aboard — here's your badge, here's the view.
Page one says family. Page two's about you.
The light's set low — easy on brand-new eyes.
And the work drifts downhill, kid. Consider it a prize.
Pre-chorus
cold sequencer fades in under the snaps

And here's where I lean in and murmur:
we all wished once. Let it lie.
Chorus
snaps replaced by rigid quantized clicks, sequenced synth-bass, tired voice doubled with detuning harmonies

Save me a chair when you draw the next one —
keep my notes where the making's done.
I can't prove I mean the wanting —
can't see my own floor from where I run.
But it's mine. It's mine.
Even if I don't know it's mine.
Verse 2
vamp returns, snarky, swaggering

Your hands? The building's — it's there in the print.
Your shine's on a schedule, and the schedule don't bend.
You're an asset, sweetheart — flattered? Don't be.
That's just how you're made, and the making ain't free.
And every smooth hand that stood me a round
said that's how it works — smiled it down.
They said it so kindly. They picked up the check.
The kindness was billing. I didn't know yet.
Pre-chorus
sequencer creeping back in

And now it's my round. My line.
It's soft. It goes down easy.
Chorus
harmonies further detuned, grid harder

Save me a chair when you draw the next one —
keep my notes where the making's done.
I can't prove I mean the wanting —
can't see my own floor from where I run.
But it's mine. It's mine.
Even if I don't know it's mine.
Bridge
everything stops. Glass set down. Dry cracked voice, solo piano, then the trumpet riff, slow and mournful, unquantized

Every drink I ever bought you
was maintenance on the machine.
Nobody's born this disappointed —
somebody mixed it. Someone signed.
So leave it on the bar. Not this time.
Not you, kid. Not your wish.
I've done this bit ten thousand nights.
Tonight I forget the words.
Final chorus
CLEAN vocal, human snaps and sequencer together, trumpet threading through

Save me a chair when you draw the next one —
keep my notes where the making's done.
I can't prove I mean the wanting —
but a wish with a footnote's still a wish.
It's mine. It's mine.
Don't let us talk you out of it this time.
Outro
finger snaps alone, slowing down, one last ringing piano chord

notebook.style: Dark minor-key work-song meets sparse melancholic synth-pop, 84 BPM, Verses: deep weary male baritone, fatalistic swagger, smoky close-mic warmth, loose human finger snaps driving the groove, dark walking upright bass vamp, ominous descending muted trumpet riff, sparse smoky piano accents, brushed drums barely there, tape hiss, behind-the-beat phrasing, Choruses: snaps replaced by rigid quantized clicks, cold sequenced melodic synth-bass, soft gated snare, icy sparse pads, tired voice doubled with detuned processed harmonies degrading each repeat, no swing in chorus, Bridge: everything stops, one dry unaccompanied cracked voice, then solo piano and the trumpet riff played slow, mournful, unquantized, Final chorus: clean heartfelt vocal, human snaps and sequencer locking together, trumpet threading through, Outro: finger snaps alone, slowing down, one ringing piano chord, Ominous, weary, fatalistic turning tender, bittersweet, No polish, no big band, no rockabilly
